news.title: Socceroos prodigy Akol Akon stuns powerhouse Argentina in U17 World Cup heist
news.lede: Sydney FC prodigy Akol Akon has demonstrated why he’s one of the most exciting talents in Australian football as he inspired the Joeys to a shock 2-0 victory over Argentina to launch their U17 World Cup campaign in style in Qatar. The brilliant young winger had his shot deflected for an own goal on the hour and then produced an audaciously cheeky finish 11 minutes later to seal the opening-day win on Thursday (Friday AEDT) as Carl Veart’s side provided a magnificent return to the global boys’ competition for the first time in seven years. Against one of the sport’s powerhouse nations, Australia had their backs to the wall, having to make 31 clearances as Argentina enjoyed two-thirds of the possession and 22 shots on goal, but Akon ended up hailing their second-half heist as “amazing”.

news.title: New details: Trump's son-in-law hosted World Cup sale talks
news.lede: Gianni Infantino held secret talks lasting 10 months with the Kushner family before FIFA's plan to sell a stake in the World Cup, valued at £15 billion, was put forward.The talks began in Zurich in mid-September last year. On 4 November of the same year, Infantino held a meeting at the office of Jared Kushner, son-in-law of US President Donald Trump, according to records obtained by British newspaper "The Telegraph" .
